documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter/Half Year Ended 30 September 2026

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited held its analyst and investor meet for Q2 and the financial year ended March 31, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores and a net profit of Rs. 34 crores. Management highlighted that the water technologies business grew strongly, while construction chemicals and distribution faced headwinds from a prolonged monsoon and team changes in the first half but rebounded well in the second half. The company noted rising input costs from metals like zinc and molybdenum and the invocation of force majeure, which impacted immediate margins.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook continues to remain positive.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenues in the construction chemicals and distribution segments to go up in Q3 and Q4.
guidance.quote: So Construction chemical was down by 6% and distribution by 30%, but yes, we expect in Q3 and Q4 these segments would go up.

guidance.claim: Management states that the water technologies business would probably grow at a rate of 10 to 15% year on year.
guidance.quote: So we see a steady growth of seven to 8% in the market, but we would probably grow at a rate of 10 to 15% year on year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that all businesses have strong sales pipelines and the sales growth outlook is positive across all business units.
demand_outlook.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects volume growth in construction chemicals of around 15% to 20% for the first quarter of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects volume growth in water chemicals to be roughly around 10%.
demand_outlook.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units according to executive commentary.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed stability in the supply chain with equipment and system deliveries remaining on schedule.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing stability in our supply chain and equipment and system deliveries are also on schedule.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that material costs started increasing from the end of February and March, accompanied by volatility in metals.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March. A lot of volatility in metals before that.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA increased on account of good gross margins and improved cost optimization.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased on account of good, good gross margins what we had and improved cost optimization.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated PBT and margins improved due to lower raw material costs and new product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated PBT for second quarter 25-26 was at Rs. 9.62 crores, again up by 6% as compared to last quarter. So improved margins were on account of lower raw material cost and new product technologies which we brought in and our outlook remains positive across all business units.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the water business is starting the financial year with a strong order book for both chemicals and equipment systems.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also. Equipment systems are of course on the order book we have, but even the chemicals we have contracts running till late in this financial year before they come up for renewal.

orders_capacity.claim: Equipment and systems deliveries in the Water BU are on schedule.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipment and systems deliveries on schedule

orders_capacity.claim: The water business unit has a strong order book of almost 100 crore rupees of new order book apart from regular business.
orders_capacity.quote: As far as the order booking is concerned in the water business unit we have almost 100 plus cr. of new order book which is apart from the regular business.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the total order book in the water business, almost 85 to 90 crores is in the chemicals domain and 10 to 12 crores is in the equipment domain.
orders_capacity.quote: We have almost Rs. 100 plus CR order book which includes chemical as well as equipment’s almost Rs. 85 to Rs. 90 CR is in the chemical’s domain and Rs. 10 Cr. to Rs. 12 Cr. is in the equipment’s domain.

orders_capacity.claim: Management expects to invoice about 40 to 50 percent of the new order book within the current financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: So that's how we look at almost invoicing almost around 40 to 50% of this order in within this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Construction Chemicals BU maintained a steady revenue growth with a tight credit policy.
capital_allocation.quote: Steady revenue growth with tight credit policy

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the first half decrease in construction and distribution businesses was primarily due to a prolonged monsoon that impacted project activity.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you'll see, the first half of both the construction and the distribution businesses were low and we mentioned last time that the 15% decrease that you see here is primarily the first half, the pro longed monsoon.

risks_headwinds.claim: Material costs increased due to war impact alongside some volatility in metal compounds.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

risks_headwinds.claim: Construction chemicals experienced slow growth in Q2 alongside a prolonged monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that prolonged monsoon affected summer chemical sales and overall volumes.
risks_headwinds.quote: So this year, unfortunately, because of the prolonged monsoon, the summer chemicals could not be sold. So that's the gap that is found wanting there.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management pointed to sluggish growth in the industrial front and delayed projects impacting invoicing in the equipment business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Second is that there has been a sluggish growth in the end on the industrial front in which we operate some of the projects have been delayed quite a lot and we could not invoice those projects which are getting. Wise to slowly this year, especially in the equipment business.

management_commitments.claim: Management is internally looking at about four years to hit a 1000 crore revenue milestone.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we're looking at about four years odd to hit 1000 crore milestone, how well it gets achieved. Of course, there are a lot of external factors, but we hope to be on course to get there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
